arxiv-1902-06529.title: Search for light sterile neutrinos with the T2K far detector Super-Kamiokande at a baseline of 295 km
arxiv-1902-06529.creator: K. Abe, R. Akutsu, A. Ali, C. Andreopoulos, L. Anthony, M. Antonova, S. Aoki, A. Ariga, Y. Ashida, Y. Awataguchi, Y. Azuma, S. Ban, M. Barbi, G.J. Barker, G. Barr, C. Barry, M. Batkiewicz-Kwasniak, F. Bench, V. Berardi, S. Berkman, R.M. Berner, L. Berns, S. Bhadra, S. Bienstock, A. Blondel, S. Bolog
arxiv-1902-06529.description: Abstract We perform a search for light sterile neutrinos using the data from the T2K far detector at a baseline of 295 km, with an exposure of 14.7 (7.6) × 10 20 \times 10^{20} protons on target in neutrino (antineutrino) mode. A selection of neutral current interaction samples are also used to enhance the sensitivity to sterile mixing.

arxiv-2112-04077.title: Interface engineering of ferroelectricity in thin films of thiophosphate A ​ B AB P 2 X X 6 ( A A = Cu, Ag; B B = In, Bi, Cr, V; and X X = S, Se)
arxiv-2112-04077.creator: Guoliang Yu, Anlian Pan, Mingxing Chen
arxiv-2112-04077.description: Abstract Two-dimensional ferroelectrics (FEs) are promising in the miniaturization of memory devices with ultra-high-density data storage and low power consumption. However, many thiophosphate monolayers, i.e., analogs of CuInP 2 S 6 and referred to as ABP 2 X 6 , lose ferroelectricity and instead exhibit an antiferroelectric (AFE) or paraelectric ordering.

arxiv-2502-19704.title: Gross-Llewellyn Smith sum rule from lattice QCD
arxiv-2502-19704.creator: K. U. Can, J. A. Crawford, R. Horsley, P. E. L. Rakow, T. G. Schar, G. Schierholz, H. Stüben, R. D. Young, J. M. Zanotti, QCDSF Collaboration
arxiv-2502-19704.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by K. U. Can, J. A. Crawford, R. Horsley, P. E. L. Rakow, T. G. Schar, G. Schierholz, H. Stüben, R. D. Young, J. M. Zanotti, QCDSF Collaboration. We compute the Gross-Llewellyn Smith sum rule, i.e. the lowest odd moment of the parity-violating structure function, F 3 F_{3} , of the nucleon from a lattice QCD calculation of the Compton amplitude.

arxiv-2510-09050.description: Abstract . pmc-10670216.title: Robustness and Complexity of Directed and Weighted Metabolic Hypergraphs
pmc-10670216.creator: Pietro Traversa, Guilherme Ferraz de Arruda, Alexei Vazquez, Yamir Moreno
pmc-10670216.description: Metabolic networks are probably among the most challenging and important biological networks. Their study provides insight into how biological pathways work and how robust a specific organism is against an environment or therapy. Here, we propose a directed hypergraph with edge-dependent vertex weight as a novel framework to represent metabolic networks.

pmc-11337721.title: Temporal distribution and ecological risk assessment for pesticides in water from the north-central coastal zone of Sinaloa, Mexico
pmc-11337721.creator: José Belisario Leyva-Morales, Pedro de Jesús Bastidas-Bastidas, Vilma del Carmen Salvatierra-Stamp, Luis Carlos González-Márquez, Yasser A Davizon, Henri Márquez-Pacheco, Jesús Mateo Amillano-Cisneros, Edgar Cruz-Acevedo, Bianca Anabel Amézquita-López, Claudia Romo Gómez, Zamaria Yoselin De la Torre
pmc-11337721.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Water contamination with pesticides is one of the major pollution problems in northwestern Mexico, and this is due to the extensive use of pesticides in agriculture. In this research, water samples of ten sampling sites (fishing grounds, beaches, and both) were analyzed in the search for 28 pesticides (organochlorines, organophosphates, pyrethroids, carbamates, among other chemical classes), supplemented with a calculation of the resulting potential environmental risk.

pmc-11516564.title: How to rank schools of public health? The PHAR project
pmc-11516564.creator: A Dugerdil, A Chiolero, A Flahault
pmc-11516564.description: BackgroundSince the shattering and abrupt withdrawal of several Ivy League universities from ranking systems in 2022, the debate on rankings has been raging in the academic world and beyond. Despite this, rankings have undeniable advantages and continue to be used on a daily basis by a variety of stakeholders.

pmc-11715750.title: Blood‐brain barrier breakdown and abnormal brain microstructure in older adults with COVID‐19‐related cognitive impairment are modified by sex and APOE4
pmc-11715750.creator: Emilie T Reas, Austin T Alderson‐Myers, Seraphina K Solders, Qian Shen, Xin Wang, Charlotte S Rivera, Sarah Banks, Jennifer Graves
pmc-11715750.description: BackgroundPersistent neurological symptoms including cognitive impairment can follow SARS‐CoV‐2 infection, a condition termed neurological post‐acute sequelae of COVID‐19 (Neuro‐PASC). Structural brain differences have been observed in individuals with Neuro‐PASC, raising concern that COVID‐19 may promote age‐related neurodegeneration. However, the mechanisms by which COVID‐19 impairs cognition and its impact on brain aging, remain poorly characterized.

pmc-12834986.title: Quinic acid attenuates arsenic-induced hepatic injury and hyperglycemia in mice via GLUT2 upregulation and suppression of oxidative stress and inflammation
pmc-12834986.creator: Seyedeh Diba Aghamirzadeh, Mohammad Javad Khodayar, Mehrnoush Matin, Annahita Rezaie, Mehrnoosh Moosavi
pmc-12834986.description: Chronic exposure to arsenic is associated with an increased risk of developing diabetes mellitus. Quinic acid (QA), a cyclic polyol compound with known antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, was evaluated for its protective effects against sodium arsenite (SA)-induced hyperglycemia and hepatotoxicity in mice.

uslaw-usc-t43-s411a1.title: 43 U.S.C. § 411a–1 — Authorization of appropriations for investigations of feasibility of reclamation projects
uslaw-usc-t43-s411a1.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t43-s411a1.description: United States Code, Title 43 (Public Lands); Chapter 12 (Reclamation And Irrigation Of Lands By Federal Government); Subchapter III (Institution And Construction Of Projects). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The sum of $125,000 annually is authorized to be appropriated for cooperative and miscellaneous investigations of the feasibility of reclamation projects.
